introduction: Jonathan Fielding is a theater artist who lives in Irvington, New York.In the theater he has served as an actor, a director, a playwright, an administrator, and producer. He studied theater/television at Texas Christian University and went on to receive his master’s degree from Rutgers University, Mason Gross School of the Arts.As a theater performer he has appeared on Broadway in The Play That Goes Wrong at the Lyceum, Noises Off and Pygmalion with Roundabout Theater Company, and The Seagull at the Walter Kerr. Jonathan has also worked for many regional theaters across the USA.He co-founded the Harbor Stage Company in Wellfleet, MA where he still produces new and classical plays. For over 20 years he has also been an Artistic Associate with Amphibian Stage Productions, in Fort Worth, TX.As a writer and collaborator he co-created the multi-media play 1905 with the Agnes Table which earned a residency at UMASS Amherst and enjoyed a sold out run. He co-wrote the play Northside Hollow with playwright and performer Brenda Withers which has received full productions in Massachusetts, Texas, and Florida. Jonathan also co-created The Ballad of Bobby Botswain with Jason Lambert which enjoyed a world premiere at the Harbor Stage Company.On television he has performed roles on “Gotham”, “The Gilded Age”, “FBI: Most Wanted”, “Law and Order: SVU”, and “Castle Rock”. He played Ricky in the feature film Dindin produced by Harbor Pictures.
